issuing_body: U.S. District Court, District of Minnesota (court order reproduced by third-party archive)
title: United States v. Ahmed Sharif Omar-Hashim, second preliminary forfeiture order, ECF 874

acquisition.channel: Court order transcribed by third-party archive; original PDF not independently downloaded

supports: ECF 874 dated May 18, 2026 grants the government's second motion and orders forfeiture of the real property located at 2722 and 2742 Park Avenue South, Minneapolis.
The order states Omar-Hashim shall receive credit against his existing money judgment for the net forfeited value of each asset including his twenty percent interest in the property.
The order sets future notice and third-party petition procedures before clear title passes; it does not document a sale or realization.
does_not_support: That 100 percent of the property's net value is Omar-Hashim's share.
That proceeds of a sale were received by the government.
A standalone new money judgment in addition to the first forfeiture order ECF 653.
That the value of the 20 percent interest can be computed from acquisition purchase price without actual sale/assessment records.
notes: Reconciliation target: compare underlying parcel with property identified in Said forfeiture ECF 805, government motion ECF 868, and co-owner records. Do not double count same parcel.
